newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco unit says acquires Stemco unit.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco unit says acquires Stemco unit.

text.p: Tenneco Inc's Tenneco Automotive said Wednesday it acquired the heavy-duty truck exhaust operations of Coltec Industries Inc's Stemco Inc unit.
Terms were not disclosed. It will become part of Tenneco's Walker Manufacturing unit, Tenneco said. Stemco had 1995 revenues of $21 million and produces mufflers, pipe, band clamps and flex tubing.

"This addition significantly expands and strengthens Walker's position within the important heavy-duty segment of the market," Tenneco chairman and chief executive officer Dana Mead said in a statement.

The companies had little customer overlap and Stemco provides a platform for Walker to grow in Europe, Tenneco said. "This acquisition also provides us with an opportunity to fully participate in the truck dealer distribution channel and enter the specialty vehicle manufacturer market," said Walker president Tom Evans.
Tenneco Automotive, with sales of nearly $3 billion, is a unit of Greenwich, Conn.-based Tenneco Inc, which had 1995 revenues of $8.9 billion.
